42.22.2 STABLE Released 2026-11-27 12:00 UTC Updating your game client and previous, unmodded saves By default your Steam client will automatically update to the latest version of the game, build 42.22. We work to ensure that previous save games can be continued in new versions, and for a completely un-modded, "vanilla" version of the game, your save game should work fine.
